entities.name: Ernő Kiss
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Ernő Kiss was a honvéd lieutenant-general. He was executed for his part in the Hungarian Revolution of 1848 and is considered one of the 13 Martyrs of Arad. Ernő Kiss was from a Transylvanian family with Armenian roots.
